label: Transaction Building
description: Create, sign, combine, and broadcast transactions separately.

methods.name: createtx

params.name: action
params.description: Transaction type: none, open, bid, reveal, redeem, register, update, renew, transfer, finalize, revoke.
Action-specific parameters (same as corresponding send* command).

methods.notes: Bid nonces are saved at creation time.

methods.name: signtx
methods.description: Sign a PSTX with the wallet's private key.

params.name: hex
params.description: Hex-encoded PSTX from createtx or combinetx.

response.name: pstx
response.description: Updated PSTX hex with signatures added.

response.name: signatures
response.description: Number of signatures present after signing.

methods.notes: For multisig, each cosigner calls signtx, then merges with combinetx.

methods.name: combinetx
methods.description: Merge multiple partially-signed transactions into one.

params.name: hexes
params.description: JSON array of PSTX hex strings (minimum 2).

response.name: pstx
response.description: Combined PSTX hex with merged signatures.

methods.notes: No --wallet required. All PSTXs must be for the same transaction.

methods.name: broadcasttx
methods.description: Finalize a fully-signed PSTX and broadcast to the network.

response.name: txid
response.description: Transaction hash of the broadcast transaction.
